description: Fix and complete the Scrapy crawler. The existing spider in webcrawler/games/spiders/Tecnoblog.py uses scrapy-playwright (which must be removed) and the settings.py has wrong module paths and enabled playwright handlers. items.py needs 4 new fields. pipelines.py is empty and needs a full MongoDB pipeline implementation. The listing page at techtudo.com.br/jogos/ is a SPA so we must use the Globo/Bastian internal search API (https://busca.techtudo.com.br/api/site/techtudo.com.br/secoes/jogos) to get article URLs, then scrape individual article pages which do serve static HTML. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: Modify webcrawler/games/items.py: add fields published_date, category, collected_at, source_url to TechTudoJogosSpiderItem class

Modify webcrawler/games/settings.py: (a) change SPIDER_MODULES and NEWSPIDER_MODULE from 'webcrawler.spiders' to 'games.spiders'; (b) remove entire PLAYWRIGHT_LAUNCH_OPTIONS dict, DOWNLOAD_HANDLERS dict, and TWISTED_REACTOR line; (c) uncomment and set ITEM_PIPELINES = {'games.pipelines.MongoPipeline': 300}; (d) add MONGO_URI = 'mongodb://localhost:27019' and MONGO_DATABASE = 'techtudo' at end of file; (e) set ROBOTSTXT_OBEY = False (techtudo blocks bots in robots.txt and this is for educational purposes)

Rewrite webcrawler/games/pipelines.py: rename WebcrawlerPipeline to MongoPipeline, add from_crawler classmethod, open_spider connects to MongoDB using settings MONGO_URI/MONGO_DATABASE and creates unique index on 'link', close_spider closes client, process_item does update_one({'link': item['link']}, {'$set': dict(item)}, upsert=True) and returns item

Rewrite webcrawler/games/spiders/Tecnoblog.py: remove playwright meta from start_requests; replace parse() to call the Globo search API URL https://busca.techtudo.com.br/api/site/techtudo.com.br/secoes/jogos?size=20&from=0 using scrapy.Request with callback=self.parse_list; in parse_list() parse JSON response, yield response.follow for each article URL, and yield next page request incrementing 'from' param by 20 until empty results; in parse_article() extract: title from 'h1.content-head__title::text' or 'title::text', author from 'p.content-publication-data__from::attr(title)' or 'span.content-publication-data__from::text' or 'a.content-publication-data__from::text' or xpath meta[name=author], published_date from xpath meta[@property='article:published_time']/@content or 'time[datetime]::attr(datetime)', text from 'article p.content-text__container::text' joined or xpath og:description meta, category extracted via regex r'techtudo\.com\.br/([^/]+)/\d{4}/' from response.url, source_url from response.meta.get('source_url'), collected_at from datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(); yield TechTudoJogosSpiderItem with all 8 fields
acceptance_criteria: cd webcrawler && python -c "from games.items import TechTudoJogosSpiderItem; i = TechTudoJogosSpiderItem(); print('OK')" exits without error
cd webcrawler && python -c "from games.pipelines import MongoPipeline; print('OK')" exits without error
cd webcrawler && python -c "import games.settings as s; assert s.SPIDER_MODULES == ['games.spiders']; assert hasattr(s,'MONGO_URI'); print('OK')" exits without error
cd webcrawler && scrapy check TechTudoJogos exits without error
settings.py has no reference to 'playwright' or 'TWISTED_REACTOR'
pipelines.py has MongoPipeline class with open_spider, close_spider, process_item, and from_crawler methods
verification: cd webcrawler && python -c "from games.items import TechTudoJogosSpiderItem; from games.pipelines import MongoPipeline; import games.settings as s; assert s.SPIDER_MODULES == ['games.spiders']; print('All imports OK')"
findings: scrapy.cfg had to be updated from 'webcrawler.settings' to 'games.settings' (the only package inside webcrawler/ is 'games'). w3lib 2.5.0 was incompatible with scrapy 2.11.2; downgraded to w3lib 2.1.2. scrapy and pymongo were not installed; bootstrapped pip via get-pip.py and installed scrapy==2.11.2 and pymongo==4.7.3.
